title: Destinota tikraq Oferta
intro: Runaq qallariy p’unchayninkunapin huk alma ch’uya yuyaywan huk regalota haywariq. Chaywanpas envidiakuyqa chaskikuypa llanthunpim pakakurqa. Kay figuraq willakuyninta tariy, piedadninpas llakikuy tukukuyninpas mana wañuqmanmi tukupun Diospa revelacionninpi.
clues: Señorniyman huk ofrendata haywarqani, chaymi allinpaq qhawarisqa karqan.
Wawqeypa haywasqanqa manan chaskisqachu karqan, envidiakuymi sonqonta tutayachirqan.
Nirqanim: ‘Wañuchiwanaykipaq makiykita haywariwanki chayqa, manam makiyta haywasaqchu wañuchinaypaq; cheqaqtapunin manchakuni Allahta, kay pachakunaq Señornin’, nispa.
Kay pachapi punta kaq wañuchinakuypa ñakarichisqanmi karqani.
Yawarniymi qaparirqa, chaymi mana huchayoq kaspa punta kaq mártir karqani.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
